signals.rationale: The listener nods his head affirmatively while the speaker makes his point about no German in their right mind having a taste for war.
The speaker delivers his statement with a clear, steady voice and without any filler words or hesitation. He maintains direct eye contact and an upright posture throughout his turn.
The listener maintains steady, focused eye contact with the speaker and nods slightly while listening. His attentive gaze and slight head tilt demonstrate active engagement with the speaker's words.

The speaker exhibits physical signs of tension, including a noticeable swallow and a slight lip lick before speaking. His speech is also broken up with a filler word, and his voice sounds slightly strained.
